name: mica
description: Versioned, structured content blocks for Obsidian — fast nested tabs and grids with first-class version history and Meld-class diffing.

scripts.wasm: wasm-pack build crates/mica-core --target web --release --out-dir ../../src/wasm/pkg && rm -f src/wasm/pkg/mica_core_bg.wasm.d.ts
scripts.build: pnpm run wasm && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test:rust

author: DevGuyRash
